CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Crafts with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.

   D. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rugby and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Basketball and Logo Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. D — The speed of the music
